newEntriesNeeded.title: PMLTAGS Object for Engineering Tag Export
newEntriesNeeded.principle: PMLTAGS is a system object providing methods to export engineering tag data to XLSX format via GridControl integration.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Create via object PMLTAGS(), then call exportasxls(groupName, listName, filePath) to export a list definition's data.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern:
!tags = PMLTAGS()  -- missing OBJECT keyword
!!tags.exportxls(...)  -- wrong method name
pitfalls: Must use OBJECT keyword before PMLTAGS()
exportasxls requires valid LSTDEF groupName, listName, and writable file path
File path must include .xlsx extension for correct export format

newEntriesNeeded.title: RAMCOMMONLOGGER Custom Error Logger Object
newEntriesNeeded.principle: RAMCOMMONLOGGER is a project-specific PML object for logging macro errors and warnings to Excel files.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Create via object RAMCOMMONLOGGER(), use addHeading() to set column headers, writeErrorDataToExcel() to dump log data.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB JDE_BI_tagRegister-export.pmlmac
!!ramCommonLogger = object RAMCOMMONLOGGER()
!headings = |Tag Name;Attribute Name;Error Text|
!!ramCommonLogger.addHeading(!headings.split(|;|))
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern:
!rc = object RAMCOMMONLOGGER()  -- use !! for global
!!ramCommonLogger.writeErrorDataToExcel(!logFile, true)  -- second arg is append flag
pitfalls: Must be declared as global (!!) for cross-method access
addHeading expects semicolon-separated string that is split()
writeErrorDataToExcel second parameter controls append mode

newEntriesNeeded.title: MEASURE and UNIT Objects for Unit Conversion
newEntriesNeeded.principle: MEASURE and UNIT are PML system objects for working with engineering units and conversions.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Create MEASURE('name') to get a measure object, then setunits(unit) to configure. Create UNIT('name') to get a unit reference.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB JDE_BI_tagRegister-export.pmlmac
!AngularFrequencyDimension = object MEASURE('AngularFrequency')
!rpmUnit = object UNIT(|rpm|)
!AngularFrequencyDimension.setunits(!rpmUnit)
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern:
!measure = MEASURE('AngularFrequency')  -- missing OBJECT
!unit = UNIT('rpm')  -- missing OBJECT
pitfalls: Both MEASURE and UNIT require OBJECT keyword
setunits() may fail silently if unit is not valid for the measure

newEntriesNeeded.title: LSTDEF Collection Query Pattern
newEntriesNeeded.principle: PML1 'var !name collect all LSTDEF with (expression)' queries list definitions by name and returns a GRID collection.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Use 'var !grid collect all LSTDEF with (LSTNAM eq |listName|)' to find a single list definition. Access via !grid.first().dbref() and !grid.size().
newEntriesNeeded.syntax:
var !grid collect all LSTDEF with (LSTNAM eq |IM-tag-dataset|)
if (!grid.size() eq 1) then
  !gridRef = !grid.first().dbref()
  !gridRef.lstflt = !realUnset
endif
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB RAMBiReportExport.pmlmac
var !grid collect all LSTDEF with (LSTNAM eq |IM-tag-dataset|)
if (!grid.size() eq 1) then
  !gridRef = !grid.first().dbref()
  !gridRef.lstflt = !realUnset
endif
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern:
var !grid collect all LSTDEF  -- missing 'with' filter
if (!grid.size() gt 0) then  -- should check eq 1 for uniqueness
pitfalls: LSTDEF query returns a GRID, not a single DBREF
Always check !grid.size() eq 1 before accessing first()
CATNAM of LSTGRP of $!gridRef extracts the list group name for export
$!gridRef uses query substitution, not direct method call
